description: list_dir on a listing past 64 KiB with a name that is not UTF-8. A run_shell call makes 2,000 files and the bad name first; the name starts with a, so it sorts before the cut. Then the turn ends.

input.command: mkdir many && cd many && for i in $(seq 2000); do : > "file-with-a-long-name-to-fill-the-listing-$i"; done && : > "$(printf 'a\377\376name')" && echo made

content.text: The listing came back. The job is done.
